api.notes: The attribution as plain text (upstream ReactNode). It is the name of the source, not a URL like the native blockquote cite attribute.
Markup attribution: the `cite` slot (A§7.2 content prop).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host (class, style) or ::part(base) and ::part(cite).
The element itself is the handle; the <blockquote> is reachable as part "base".

differences.text: The <blockquote> lives in the shadow root (part "base"); host aria-* attributes are mirrored onto it (AriaDelegateController) so `aria-label` names the quote as upstream's prop spread does.

`cite` is a string attribute plus a `cite` slot for markup; an empty or whitespace string renders no <cite>, like upstream's isRenderable. The attribute is the attribution text, not the URL the native cite attribute holds.
The rule keeps --color-border-emphasized (decorative, allowed at 2.2:1 by D-013 Q-05) and the text --color-text-secondary; text-wrap: pretty is added as a progressive enhancement for longer quotes.
Forced colours keep the rule as a ButtonBorder border and use CanvasText for the text.

core.blockquote.notes: Guides: [mwg:improve-text-layout-and-legibility] text-wrap: pretty on blockquote (ignored where unsupported); [mwg:accessible-web-components] aria delegation onto the inner blockquote, no footer landmark; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts base and cite.
